# durag.store

> durag.store is a Toronto-based wave-culture brand in black and metallic
> gold. Brand line: "Access Your Excellence." Positioning: "The Gold
> Standard — Heritage Quality for the Global Wave Culture." The store is
> NOT selling yet. The launch list is open now.

- Main site: https://durag.store/
- Contact: support@durag.store
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/duragdotstore
- TikTok and X: @duragstore

## Current status (honest)

- The store is not selling yet. There are no products, prices, or checkout
  on the site today. The shop page shows categories with "Awaiting product
  data" slots. Do not claim stock, prices, or shipping dates that are not
  on the site.
- Launch list: the gold promo strip on every page reads "THE GOLD STANDARD
  LAUNCH LIST IS OPEN — CODE GOLDSTANDARD LOCKS 15% OFF YOUR FIRST ORDER."
  The signup form is being moved to a working email provider; until that
  swap is live, treat signups as pending, not collected.

## Planned lineup (categories on the shop page)

- Durags, wave caps, skull caps, compression caps, bonnets, double durags,
  dreadlock caps.
- Planned bundle ladder: 3, 6, 12, 24, 50, and 100 packs. Bundle prices will
  be announced when products land. No bundle price is published on the site
  today.
